description: Krudttårnet is a solitary round white-limewashed tower on a grass plot, with a red conical tile roof and a recessed upper storey of deep arched embrasures. The plot is empty. The night is overcast, about 13.2°C, and the wind is fresh. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. The old citadel walls are gone, and no shipyard mark is readable.
